snippet.title: Table Of Truth - Official Trailer 3 | Wishlist Now on Steam
snippet.description:
What do your friends really think of you? 

Vote on the funny ‘pros and cons’ questions in this chaotic party game. Guess what the majority thinks and bag the points. Will you leave the table as the group’s brains or as a walking disaster?

🎮 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4835870/Table_Of_Truth/
